text:
maria_nguyen: Quick heads-up — release team requested console/docs sync for v0.9.4 tomorrow. Need SDK docs regen, docsite deploy, and changelog bump. Who's on point for SDK regen and can run the smoke deploy to staging?

owen: I can handle SDK regen. Will run `npm run docs:regen` and open a PR. ETA ~10:30 PT. What's the final cutoff for docsite changes?

maria_nguyen: Cutoff for code is 12:00 PT, docs freeze at 13:00 PT so we can run regen + staging deploy. Please get changelog entries in by 11:30 so we can compile the release notes.

samir: I can do docsite staging deploy and coordinate with eng-infra. Add me on the PR for review. Also confirm if we should do a full site build or incremental.

owen: I'll include the package version bump in the same PR (package.json + docs metadata). Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/642 — still WIP.

docs-bot: Staging deploy workflow is `docs:staging-deploy`. Add the label to trigger. CI will run smoke checks and publish to staging if green.

maria_nguyen: If anyone needs to hotfix after freeze, create branches off `release/v0.9.4-hotfix`. Do not merge unrelated changes after 12:00 PT. I'll post a final checklist in #release-ops at 11:20 PT.

samir: Quick question — do we need API reference regen for python SDK too? The JS regen script is in the mono repo but I don't see the py steps documented.

owen: Good catch. I will run the Python build as well: `make -C python-sdk docs` then upload artifacts to the docs repo. That usually takes ~12m. I'll add the commands to the PR description.

devops: Heads up — there's a maintenance window on staging nodes tonight at 22:00 PT. If the deploy hits that, we'll fallback to canary region eu-west-1 and re-run smoke checks.

maria_nguyen: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll ping again at 11:15 with the final go/no-go and post the merge order. :thumbsup:
